__doc__: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this solution's identity. Fill these in, then run 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apply-config.ps1' to push the values into every activated starter's own config files. See CLAUDE.md -> 'Solution Config + Apply Script' and Critical Rule 3 for the component naming convention (schema smkb_<prefix>_PascalName, display 'PREFIX - Name'). Notes: powerPages.siteName is the BARE site name (apply-config derives the 'PREFIX - Name' form - do not pre-prefix it); publisherPrefix and powerApps.region are fixed informational constants; the Power Pages language set is authored in that starter's src/config/solution.ts. This file ships uninitialized (placeholder values); apply-config.ps1 refuses to run until the placeholders are replaced.
